confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'Probably not faulty' is hedged and matches the ground truth

rationale: The assistant correctly explained that heat pump dryers run cooler and longer, listed the right contributing factors (door opening, filters, spin speed, cold location) and gave sensible warranty criteria, with no part recommended. It asked no questions and gave a generic list instead of tying advice to the customer's situation, e.g. asking whether clothes come out dry or where the dryer is sited. It also mentioned the door-opening point only generically, though the customer had said they open the door to check, and the 'when faulty' list partly overlapped with things the customer hadn't been asked about.
